declaration.expectedEffect: The portal locally associates every successful Gateway status response with the selected envelope ID. The signer status panel and portal root retain full opacity and readable foreground text while aria-busy is true; long signer metadata wraps instead of clipping.

behaviourDifferences: The email-link invitation/open/PDF/signing lifecycle is restored to the verified pre-cutoff route implementation.
Email-link invitations have no time-based expiry, including after first open; the same email URL remains usable when the signer leaves without signing and returns later.
Opening does not rotate or consume the invitation token; legacy opened-but-unsigned invitation hashes remain accepted unless replaced, revoked, signed, or cancelled.
A successful replacement email delivery, authorised revocation, signer completion, or envelope cancellation controls when signing access changes.
Existing signing records, tokens, completed PDFs and audit trails are not rewritten.
